notes.title: Devlog #2 for Update 0.2.2.0 - Seasons, Brightness & Fertilizer Features
notes.content:
[h1]General Brightness & Post-Processing Settings[/h1]
Some players had trouble navigating in darker environments. This was due to our different settings for various weather types. We’ve now adjusted the post-processing effects for all weather conditions, both day and night. As a result, interiors and exteriors are now always bright enough to find your way around comfortably.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/2b833cb0ecdf5b48af1a10c8c926825741d9729b.gif[/img]

[h1]Seasons[/h1]
In addition to the new brightness adjustments, the weather system has also been reworked: it’s no longer completely random. Instead, you’ll now experience season-typical conditions:
[list]
[*]December to February: Winter
[*]March to May: Spring
[*]June to August: Summer
[*]September to November: Autumn
[/list]
[i]Note: This is based on in-game time, not real-world time or your PC calendar.[/i]

[b]Reminder:[/b] Your in-game calendar may reset with this update. If that happens, don’t worry — no progress will be lost. The game will simply start on March 1st.

[h1]Horse Editor UI Overhaul[/h1]
The Horse Editor has received a fresh, cleaner design!  
Additionally, these changes have been made:
[list]
[*]A new button lets you open your screenshot folder directly
[*]Camera and horse rotation are now controlled with the mouse instead of buttons
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/79fbb26aecea3954daff41168569b6596e08879e.png[/img]

[h1]Fertilizer[/h1]
Until now, processed fertilizer could only be sold — that changes now!  
From now on, you can fertilize:
[list]
[*]Fields
[*]Raised beds
[*]Trees
[/list]
to boost your harvest yields.

[h1]Multiple Names for Your Horses[/h1]
At the community’s request, we’ve added the ability for horses to carry two names at once.  
Additionally, the UI for renaming horses in the Horse Editor and during purchase has been slightly updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/6229923e5bd95eef24f33890450dc46f1c3383a9.png[/img]

[h1]Horse Poop Function[/h1]
The poop system has been completely rebuilt. Horses will now only poop twice per day — once in the morning and once in the evening. Old piles disappear the next day (at 6:00 AM). There's now a system behind it — previously, it was random.

[h1]Sound Effects[/h1]
We’ve started integrating new sound effects. Each one is carefully edited, trimmed, and acoustically optimized.  
To avoid repetitive patterns, several variations of similar sounds are used.

[h2]Tack Sets – Rework[/h2]
We’re currently working on updating the Kingston, Kentucky, and L'Aquila tack sets to give them a fresher and more fitting look for Unbridled.  
Here’s a preview of the Kentucky and L'Aquila sets:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/298b962f55ca00d15a1b0de154277f9fc03d9ea8.gif[/img]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
As the number of functions, variables, and macros continued to grow, the code became increasingly complex. To address this, we’ve invested time in a thorough cleanup and restructuring process.  
Our goal was to remove redundant elements, improve organization, and significantly increase readability and maintainability. These measures lay a more stable foundation for future development and long-term maintenance.

[h2]Note[/h2]
All content is currently in [b]WIP (Work in Progress)[/b] status and may change before release!
[b]As always, you can follow our progress live on our public roadmap:  [/b]
[h2][url=https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVIpbJVlE=/]>> View public roadmap here <<[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Devlog #1 for Update 0.2.2.0 - UI, Tools & Tack Sets in Focus
notes.content:
[b]Job Board – Rework[/b]
In our last team meeting, we reviewed all menus and their associated user interfaces. The Job Board stood out the most: while it served its purpose, it was far from visually appealing. 
Alongside newly created board meshes, we’ve now added job offers in the form of flyers. The entire board – including the flyers – is interactive and much more engaging and easy to navigate. Jobs are now divided into categories and can be instantly recognized thanks to custom-made stamps, even before you interact with the board.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/76112d273924f139bb99313f7c086f04ae98d031.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/3036ecebaec33afb469c503dd89b6aedf7d73e11.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/4f4027e50e42a4bae8c0a05f627014713e646f23.png[/img]

[b]Player Creator & Horse Creator – UI Rework[/b]
The user interfaces and overall menu layout have also been reworked. Navigation in both menus is now handled with vector graphics, represented by clear, easy-to-recognize icons. In addition, some information and buttons have been rearranged. The camera can now be controlled with the right mouse button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/540d87ebc8524692bc56a64ea9b90e182147fb43.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/a0e98cafa0924947c2a02ef04705050a333a0571.png[/img]

[b]Tree Chopping & Ore Mining – Rework[/b]
Interacting with chop-able trees and mineable rocks now works similarly to other interactive world objects, such as doors. The key difference is that players now have two new equipment slots in their inventory, where the required tool must be equipped in order to interact with trees or rocks. 
The meshes for the axe and pickaxe, along with their animations, have also been reworked. These adjustments were necessary to make interactions independent of FPS.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/8fca28b69647075ead0c7718cff3acb850f24346.png[/img]

[b]Tack Sets – Rework[/b]
We’re currently working on updating the Kingston, Kentucky, and L'Aquila tack sets to give them a fresher and more fitting look for Unbridled. Here’s a preview of the Kingston Tack Set along with some new design ideas.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/44d274a944d53b38572b35223b0310addfe79f5c.gif[/img]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
In addition to these larger changes, we’re also working on smaller adjustments and quality-of-life improvements. These include quick access to the mailbox via the menu bar as well as new highlight effects when interacting with certain world objects.

[b]Public Roadmap[/b]
We’re constantly updating our public roadmap to keep everyone informed: 
[h3][url=https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVIpbJVlE=/]>> Visit the Roadmap here <<[/url][/h3]

_________

All content is currently in WIP (Work in Progress) status and may change before release!

notes.title: Early Access 0.2.0.2 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Another small update with important bug fixes, thank you for your continued feedback!

[h2]Fixes & Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Trees and rocks weren’t resetting correctly[/b] – this has been fixed.  
[*] [b]Riding school jobs weren’t available[/b] – the timer reset when restarting the game, this has been resolved.  
[*] [b]New session titles added for multiplayer[/b]: “Training” and “Open for all”.  
[*] [b]Mouse test riding didn’t work[/b] – this issue is now fixed.  
[*] [b]Stirrups changed color when mounting[/b] – now behaves correctly.  
[*] [b]Hotbar no longer highlighted in the inventory[/b] – the first row is now correctly marked again.  
[*] [b]Word filter updated[/b] – “Princess” and “Prince” are now allowed.  
[*] [b]Obstacle stands saved in the editor[/b] were resetting to default when spawned – this is fixed.  
[*] [b]Riding helmets disappeared after entering training[/b] – this bug is now fixed.  
[*] [b]Clothing reverted & items were removed[/b] – e.g. black riding pants, high boots, and black helmet – now fixed.  
[*] [b]Improved save functionality implemented[/b] – data should now save more reliably.  
[*] [b]Processor time calculation now updates properly[/b] – even when time is skipped.  
[*] [b]Planters and field contents didn’t load or couldn’t be harvested properly[/b] – this issue is resolved.  
[*] [b]Sleeping didn’t switch to the next month correctly[/b] – the cause was a calculation that only worked in the engine but not in the packaged game.  
[*] [b]Inventory & equipment sometimes didn’t save[/b] when switching to the Player Creator or Obstacle Course Builder – now fixed.  
[*] [b]Font changed for stall box names[/b] – now more readable.  
[*] [b]Tack set “Kentucky Polka” renamed to “Polka Dots”[/b].  
[*] [b]Doviran bridles without flash noseband[/b] are now displayed correctly.  
[*] [b]Horse sale prices adjusted[/b] – values have been corrected.  
[*] [b]Lead change issue with purebred horses:[/b] We were able to reproduce and fix it, and several tests went fine. However, we are not 100% sure if it could still occur in rare cases.  
[*] [b]Movement bug after picking up objects in multiplayer:[/b] Sometimes triggered after chopping trees, we could not reproduce it again, but are keeping an eye on it.  
[*] [b]Axe hit detection fixed[/b] – should now work more reliably.  
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life / Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added storage area in the garden[/b]  
[*] [b]Added saddle pad hanger in grooming area and blanket hanger on the other side[/b]  
[*] [b]Blanket hangers now support blankets with neck attachments[/b]  
[*] [b]Horse market cycle adjusted[/b] – there will now always be at least one purebred horse available  
[/list]

notes.title: What to Expect in 0.2.0.0 - Development Summary
notes.content:
[h3]On April 10, 2025, we held a team meeting to discuss the upcoming Update 0.2.0.0 as well as future plans. Here's a look at our current progress on the next major update, which is expected to launch in May![/h3]

[h1]Horse Care System[/h1]
One of the most important topics in the discussion was the Horse Care System, which will be expanded over multiple updates and improved & adjusted based on community feedback.

In the upcoming update, not all items in the stalls will be purely decorative anymore.
[list]
[*] [b]The hay net[/b] can be filled with hay that has been harvested from your own crops, or alternatively purchased from shops.  
[*] [b]The feeding trough[/b] can be filled with treats like apples or other fruits. In the future, you’ll also be able to use self-produced pellets or other feed!
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/bb6d61d9d0ac18f705ac28713dc3ca8437a286f9.gif[/img]
In addition to the health, hunger & cleanliness status displays, a new one will be added: the [b]Fatigue Bar[/b], which will be explained in more detail in a separate post.

In the current version (Early Access 0.1.0.2 – Hotfix), none of the status values are functional yet, but of course, we want to change that! We'll begin with the [b]Fatigue[/b] and [b]Hunger[/b] stats.

[h1]Stable Manager[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/c1cf74620a47511efd91246ad7a75da864098c77.png[/img]
The new Stable Manager will be accessible via a bulletin board on the ground floor of the stable. Once the player interacts with it, a map of your stable will open. This map is interactive, allowing quick and easy access to all areas of the stable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/b934206b9ab18fee415894a607fd210c03ad714e.png[/img]
When you click on a stall, you'll get a detailed overview with the following options:
[list]
[*] A horse can be assigned to the selected box. That horse will then spawn in this box going forward.  
[*] [b]The hay net & feeding trough[/b] can be filled and customized in color.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/4dd9acccd06c5bd86f9f17c68d4b83a66ad09709.png[/img]

[h1]Farming[/h1]
The farming system will expand many gameplay elements, including crafting, the horse care system, and provides another method to earn money! For this feature, the garden behind the house will become accessible.

We’ll have various types of harvestable plants. Here are some examples:
[b]Single harvest¹[/b]  
[list]
[*] Carrots  
[*] Beetroot  
[*] Grass  
[*] Various plants for creating dyes 
[/list] 
[b]Multiple harvests²[/b]  
[list]
[*] Blueberries  
[*] Apples 
[/list] 

¹Single harvest means these plants provide one yield and must be replanted afterward.  
²Multiple harvests means the plant only needs to be planted once and will regularly yield produce, like bushes or trees.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/15f5fd8fb137c2f7dd62171ff05958a69026a263.png[/img]

[h1]Hayloft[/h1]
The attic of your stable will serve as a hayloft where you can place harvested grass into several "grass dryers." Once dried, it becomes hay. You can use this hay to feed your horses, fill the hay nets, or sell it.

[h1]Crafting Expansion[/h1]
We want to introduce crafting for various types of horse tack, including gear that can only be crafted and gear that can also be purchased from NPCs. Crafting won’t just help you get special gear, but also offer a way to make money.

Alongside crafting gear, we’ll also provide the option to [b]recolor[/b] items.

[h3]Here are two example recipes:[/h3]
[b]Crafting a saddle pad[/b] (can also be purchased):  
[olist]
[*] Fabric  
[*] xxx Pax (In-game currency)
[/olist]
[b]Recoloring a saddle pad:[/b]  
[olist]
[*] White saddle pad  
[*] Red dye  
[*] xxx Pax (In-game currency) 
[/olist] 
For Update 0.2.0.0, a "handful" of new crafting options will first be added at the blacksmith.

[h1]Horse Editor[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/7eabc580140c1a5d947fbe238df7754d482e132a.png[/img]
Many of you requested the ability to rename purchased horses and change their hairstyles and color, including forelock, mane, and tail.
In the grooming area, you’ll soon be able to give your horses a whole new look!
We’ll also be adding brand-new hairstyles!

[h1]Horse Market Overhaul[/h1]
Currently, the horse market always offers the same horses. We want to change that using in-game time. Every in-game week, new horses will be available, some of them randomly generated to bring more variety. Both [b]mixed breeds[/b] and [b]purebreds[/b] will be available!

[h1]Obstacle Course Builder Expansion[/h1]
Higher jumps up to class [b]M[/b] will be added. Additionally, you’ll be able to place decoratives on the ground.

[h1]Multiplayer Communication[/h1]
To make communication with other players easier, we’ll be adding [b]preset phrases[/b] and [b]emotes[/b].

We understand that many players would love an in-game chat, but unfortunately we cannot ensure safety, especially for younger players so we’ve decided not to include this feature for now.

[h1]Mini-Map[/h1]
Some players had trouble finding their way around, so we decided to add a [b]mini-map[/b]. It will show harvestable plants like [b]Nettle[/b] and indicate your character’s current viewing direction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/c7ebf977e2e8e701504e7af39be23cabf4c2db20.png[/img]

[h1]General[/h1]
We aim to add more [b]Quality of Life[/b] features overall and to explain or implement many functions in a more user-friendly way. This will also be part of ongoing improvements spread across multiple updates. Thanks to the community’s feedback, we know where to focus our efforts!

notes.title: Early Access 0.1.0.1 - Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]General Improvements & Bug Fixes:  [/b]
[list]
[*]Players who assigned their horse to the Stamina Path did not receive EXP – this issue has been fixed.  
[*]Stamina EXP can now be earned based on stamina consumption and distance traveled.  
[*]EXP rewards are now correctly calculated.  
[*]When a path reaches the maximum level (10), this is now properly displayed in the Horse Manager.  
[*]The Agility Path now grants less EXP.  
[*]Show Jumping challenges for classes E, A, and L are now available. Hovering over the buttons will now display the requirements needed to unlock each class.  
[*]Agility EXP is now gained through automatic lead changes.  
[*]Jeremiah had an incorrectly assigned talk text that was non-functional – this has been removed.   
[*]During Show Jumping training, the horse no longer keeps moving in the background when the result screen is displayed.  
[*]Some hay decals in the Riding School had poor blending with other objects – this has been fixed.  
[*]The "Job Offer" timer now includes "h" and "m" for hours and minutes, as some players were unsure about the time format.  
[*]Some SFX could not be lowered via the settings – this issue has been fixed.  
[*]The stable entrance doors on the Riding School map now open wider to allow horses to pass through more easily. (Visually, this might look a bit odd from the outside, but until we can replace the mesh, this is the best solution.)  
[*]The text size of some hint messages has been adjusted.  
[*]A problem has been fixed where the job horses at the Riding School were no longer interactable after rejoining the map while the job was active.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Adjustments: [/b] 
[list]
[*]For jobs requiring item deliveries, items are now correctly removed from the inventory and recognized.
[*]Horses can now become Exhausted:  
[*]If a horse's stamina reaches 0, it enters the Exhausted state.  
[*]In this state, the horse is downgraded to at least "Trot."  
[*]The Exhausted status is lifted once stamina regenerates above 20%.  
[*]While Exhausted, the horse cannot go faster than "Trot" and cannot jump.  
[*]Fixed an issue where players could switch to canter during a jump even when stamina was depleted.
[*]Night can now be skipped: Starting at 18:00 (6 PM), you can interact with your bed.  
[*]A numerical error in Beginner Course 06 has been corrected.  
[*]The feeding animation has been fixed.  
[*]The Show Jumping ESC menu no longer causes players to get stuck when closing it.  
[/list]

[b]Final Notes:  [/b]
For this hotfix, we primarily focused on fixing the most common bugs, as far as it was currently possible.  
Some bugs could not be reproduced, making it difficult to identify the cause. I will reach out to certain players who encountered these issues to ask for additional details and assistance.  

[b]For your information: [/b]
As a team, we had a productive brainstorming session about the future of Unbridled: That Horse Game and the next steps ahead. Once we have cleaned up the current state of the game, we will share more details with you.  
We would like to express our gratitude to everyone for their support! It has been a bumpy start, but we are passionately moving forward. We take all feedback and suggestions seriously, and they are always open for discussion.

You decide which path your horse will take: will it become a racehorse or perhaps a jumping master? With perks, you can compensate for your horse's weaknesses or further enhance the stats it already excels in!
This is just the beginning of the system, but we are continuously working on refining it to its fullest potential.

For example, your horses will get hungry over time, you will have daily bonding tasks (such as brushing and hoof cleaning), and job offers will appear on the job board. notes.title: CLOSED BETA UPDATE 0.3.0 – OUR BIGGEST UPDATE YET! 🌟
notes.content:
[h2][b]CLOSED BETA UPDATE NEWS 🎉[/b][/h2]

[h3]It’s been a long time without an update, but we haven’t been sitting around doing nothing! Behind the scenes, we’ve been working hard on the game, and now it’s finally here – you can play the result yourself![/h3]

  - [i]Falkenberg Riding School:[/i] A stunning training and riding destination.

• [b]Gameplay Index:[/b] A growing guide with all the info you need about the game. (Not filled yet)

• [b]New Shop Items:[/b] Find new horse tack and stylish clothing at the Horse Market shop.  
• [b]New Music:[/b] A fresh track to enhance the game atmosphere.  
• [b]Expanded Horse Ownership:[/b] Own up to [i]four horses[/i] at once!
• [b]New Sleep Feature:[/b] You can now go to sleep in your room by interacting with the bed. Time will reset to 7:00.  

• [b]Beginner Show Jumping Courses:[/b] Learn the ropes of show jumping at the riding school.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/69b13b4f82691f73c2aae46129fef065547951c5.png[/img]

• [b]New Bonding Actions:[/b] You can now pat and hug your horse. ❤️  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/fa496f8d8411cedba84c955b43ad727b1d098462.png[/img]

• [b]New Item: Horse Tickets[/b]  
  - [i]Silver Ticket:[/i] Customize your horse with limited markings and colors.  
  - [i]Gold Ticket:[/i] Go all out and create your dream horse with no limits!  
• [b]New NPCs:[/b]  
  - [i]Clarissa Falkenberg:[/i] The owner of Falkenberg Riding School.  
  - [i]Florian Himmel:[/i] The shopkeeper at the Horse Market.

  - Right-click the item to automatically attach it to the correct slot.
  - Drag & Drop the item onto the correct equipment slot.
  - Drag & Drop the item directly onto the horse.
  - First, hold the item in your hand and stand in front of the horse to attach it manually.

[h3][b]CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

• [b]Player Character Upgrade:[/b] Your character has a brand-new look and improved graphics.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/4557713bb063628331ab54761450d6a281dfa1b8.png[/img]

• [b]Map Rename:[/b] "Forest Valley" is now called [i]Campground[/i] and has been reworked.  
• [b]Horse Creator & Player Creator Revamp:[/b] Both tools have been completely redesigned.
• [b]UI Overhaul:[/b] The entire user interface has been refreshed for a better experience. 
 
• [b]Improved Horse Care:[/b] More detailed grooming and hoof cleaning! Use two different brushes to remove various dirt: hard brushes like curry combs for tough dirt and soft brushes for dust.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/5d598bde9df911e98f0cca875e449864ad5fc4ea.png[/img]

• [b]Home Stable Overhaul:[/b] Your stable has been redesigned with new buildings to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/daa786bf3f46eff3515c7cb31a505ea08124f013.jpg[/img]

[i]We are actively working to resolve these issues—thank you for your patience and feedback![/i]

notes.title: Unbridled: That Horse Game is switching to Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42611847/ad3fc275643385027cd578db77708fc7c85aa3b8.png[/img]

[h3]Yep, that's right! We are moving from Unreal Engine 4 to 5![/h3]
So what does that mean?

The game will get a massive [u]performance AND graphics boost![/u]
Thanks to the new features that are provided by version 5, like Nanite and Lumen!

[b]What is Lumen?[/b]
[i]Lumen is a fully dynamic global illumination and reflections solution that enables indirect lighting to adapt on the fly to changes to direct lighting or geometry—for example, changing the sun’s angle with the time of day or opening an exterior door.
With Lumen, we no longer have to author lightmap UVs, wait for lightmaps to bake, or place reflection captures; what we see inside the Unreal Editor is what we get on console.[/i]

[b]What is Nanite?[/b]
[i]We are able to create games and worlds with massive amounts of geometric detail with Nanite, a virtualized micropolygon geometry system, and a new Virtual Shadow Map system.
We can directly import and replicate multi-million-polygon meshes while maintaining a real-time frame rate without any noticeable loss of fidelity.
These systems intelligently stream and process only the detail you can perceive, largely removing poly count and draw call constraints.[/i]

Also with the switch there will be lots of updates in the [b]Patreon test phases[/b] [i](Link down below)[/i]! The stable map, Character and the customizer, Inventory, Horse customizer, Horse animations and Obstacle Course Builder will get all a big rework! Of course new things will come as well! Stay tuned!

[u][b]This will be the biggest update yet, so please give us some time to make it work flawlessly! The free Demo will also be on Unreal Engine 5![/b][/u]
